$comment: Single source of truth for the typed IPC boundary. Edit this file, then run `npm run codegen` to regenerate src/api/ipc.generated.ts. Type expressions: string | number | boolean | null | any | unknown | void | `T[]` | `Record<string, T>` | anything else passes through raw TS. Named interfaces shared across commands live in `types` (name + raw TS body, may reference each other for recursion).

commands.name: greet
commands.doc: Placeholder greeting command (create-tauri-app scaffold). Resolves with the greeting or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_create
commands.doc: Create a media entry from manual input. Resolves with the new media id or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_list
commands.doc: List library entries with optional filters. Resolves with summary rows (each carrying its progress summary for the in-grid quick controls) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_facets
commands.returns: { formats: string[]; genres: { id: string; name: string }[]; tags: { id: string; name: string }[]; years: number[] }
commands.doc: Distinct filter values present in the library. Resolves with facet options or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_get
commands.returns: { id: string; content_type: string; format: string | null; title_main: string; title_original: string | null; synopsis: string | null; pub_status: string; start_date: string | null; end_date: string | null; release_year: number | null; language: string | null; country: string | null; content_rating: string | null; pages: number | null; duration_min: number | null; ep_count: number | null; ch_count: number | null; cover_asset_id: string | null; banner_asset_id: string | null; provider: string | null; provider_url: string | null; metadata_refreshed_at: string | null; created_at: string; updated_at: string; alt_titles: { lang: string; title: string }[]; people: string[]; genres: string[]; tags: string[]; external_ids: { provider: string; ext_id: string; url: string | null }[]; relations: { to_id: string; relation: string }[] } | null
commands.doc: Read the full aggregate for one media. Resolves with the record or null when not found; rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_search
commands.doc: Local full-text search over the library. Resolves with summary rows (each carrying its progress summary) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: search_external
commands.doc: External (provider) search grouped by provider, with identity flags. `content_type` narrows the fan-out when provided; null searches every enabled provider (domain-agnostic). Resolves with local hits + provider groups + per-provider failures, or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: import_provider
commands.doc: Import one provider title into the library (details → identity check → add). Resolves with the media that owns the title — newly created (created: true) or an existing library row the identity check matched (created: false), or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: import_file_preview
commands.doc: Parse + dedup a file (kind `json` = MyLore JSON format, `csv` = CSV with a column mapping) into the per-item preview. `mapping` is required for `csv` and ignored for `json`. Read-only. Resolves with the preview (per-row outcomes + issues) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: import_commit
commands.doc: Import a file's rows as a background task (MISSION-070): spawns the commit on the TaskManager and resolves with the initial (queued) snapshot; progress + terminal state stream as `task_changed` events and the task can be cancelled. The commit runs in one transaction, savepoint per row. `plan` selects which source rows to import; null imports every `New` row of the preview. Non-new / invalid / unselected rows are reported as skipped; a row that fails to insert rolls back its own savepoint and is reported as failed. On success the task's `result` is the per-item `ImportReport`.

commands.name: export_media
commands.doc: Export the whole library as a background task (MISSION-071): streams rows to `path` as json / csv / markdown (`format`) and resolves with the initial (queued) snapshot; progress + terminal state stream as `task_changed` events and the task can be cancelled (a cancelled export drops its partial file). The file is written to a `*.partial` sibling and renamed into place on success. On success the task's `result` is the `ExportReport` (`{ format, total, path }`).

commands.name: import_csv_headers
commands.doc: Read the header row of a CSV file for the mapping UI's column pickers. Resolves with the trimmed column names or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_enrich
commands.doc: Refresh a media's provider-owned metadata from its provider and report what changed (per-field before → after). Never touches user data (tracking, review, collections, personal tags, asset ids). Resolves with the diff view or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: providers_list
commands.doc: Snapshot every registered provider for the settings UI. Resolves with the rows in registration order, or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: provider_set_enabled
commands.doc: Toggle one provider on/off. Persists the flag and takes effect immediately (routing rebuilds the coordinator). Resolves with the updated row or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: provider_set_key
commands.doc: Store (or clear, when blank) a provider's API key in the OS keyring. The key is never persisted in settings files and never returned to the webview. Resolves with the updated row or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: provider_test_connection
commands.doc: Ping one provider with a probe search. Runs even when the provider is disabled so a key can be verified before enabling. Resolves with the test outcome (never rejects for a provider failure) or rejects with an AppError.

commands.name: dashboard_summary
commands.doc: Resolve the dashboard widget lists (continue watching, recently completed, recently added). `limit` is optional and clamped per widget (1..=20). Resolves with the DashboardSummary or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: asset_resolve
commands.doc: Resolve one cover/banner asset to a cached local file, downloading per the cache policy when needed. `status` is `cached` (local_path usable via `convertFileSrc`), `failed` (transient, retried after a cooldown) or `missing` (permanent broken URL). Resolves with the asset view or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: assets_resolve
commands.doc: Resolve many cover/banner assets in one call (deduped; unknown ids are skipped). The library grid calls this once per visible page so covers resolve as a batch. Resolves with the resolved asset views or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_nodes
commands.doc: Read the full content tree for one media (seasons→episodes, volumes→chapters) with per-node progress state. Resolves with the nested tree, roots ordered by position, or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: node_progress_set
commands.doc: Set the progress state of one node (read/watched/skipped/unread). Completed states stamp read_at. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: node_progress_range
commands.doc: Set the progress state of every node between two nodes in the media's display order. Resolves with the affected node ids (for optimistic UI) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: node_progress_next
commands.doc: Mark the next not-yet-consumed countable node of a media done (watched for episodes, read otherwise) and run the auto-status rule. Resolves with the refreshed progress summary, null when nothing is left to mark, or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_get
commands.doc: Read the tracking row for one media. Resolves with the row or null when the media is untracked; rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_set_status
commands.doc: Apply a status transition for one media (status engine applies, incl. the Repeat guard and started/finished stamps). Resolves with the updated row or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_set_auto_track
commands.doc: Toggle Normal (autoTrack) vs Manual tracking mode for one media. Resolves with the updated row (turning Normal back on re-syncs the status to the current progress) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_delete
commands.doc: Soft-delete a media: store its before-image in trash, cascade the row away. Resolves with the trash id (accepted by trash_restore for undo) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: trash_list
commands.returns: { id: string; kind: string; title: string; deleted_at: string }[]
commands.doc: List active (not restored) trash entries. Resolves with trash items or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: trash_restore
commands.doc: Restore a soft-deleted aggregate from its trash before-image. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: trash_purge
commands.doc: Permanently forget a trash entry. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: tracking_bulk_set_status
commands.doc: Set the tracking status for many media at once (status engine applies). Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_bulk_add_tag
commands.doc: Add a personal tag to many media at once (reused or created as needed). Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: media_bulk_delete
commands.doc: Soft-delete many media. Resolves with a trash id per media (for group undo) or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: collection_list
commands.doc: List collections for the add-to-list picker. Resolves with collection rows or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: collection_bulk_add
commands.doc: Add many media to one collection. Resolves or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: task_list
commands.doc: Every background task snapshot, newest first. Resolves with the list or rejects with an AppError string.

commands.name: task_get
commands.doc: The current snapshot of one background task. Resolves with the snapshot or rejects with an AppError string when the id is unknown.

commands.name: task_cancel
commands.doc: Request cancellation of a background task. The runner observes the flag at its next checkpoint (dropping its in-flight transaction). Resolves with the current snapshot or rejects with an AppError string when the id is unknown.

events.name: task-changed
events.doc: Emitted by the TaskManager whenever a background task changes state or reports progress.
